==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|aks|ax||nonstandard|or|dialectal|otherwise|obsolete}} {{defdate|post 1600}}
* {{alt|en|aske||obsolete}}

===Pronunciation===

** {{IPA|en|/ɑːsk/|a=RP}}
*** {{audio|en|En-uk-to ask.ogg|a=UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ask/|a=Northern England,Scotland}}
** {{IPA|en|/ɑːks/|a=also,MLE}}
* {{a|en|US}}
** {{IPA|en|/æsk/|a=GA,CA}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-ask.ogg|a=US}}
** {{IPA|en|[ɛəsk]|a=NYC,Philadelphia}}
** {{enPR|ăks|a=AAVE,Cajun,Nigeria,nonstandard}}, {{IPA|en|/æks/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈas(k̚), ˈɛs/|a=Singapore,Hong Kong}}

* {{homophones|en|acts|ax|axe}} {{qualifier|some dialects}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=request|:inh|enm:asken|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|asken}}, {{m|enm|axen}}, from {{inh|en|ang|āscian}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*aiskōn}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₂eys-|t=to wish; request}}. Cognate with {{cog|stq|aaskje|t=to ask, demand, require}}, {{cog|fy|easkje|t=to ask, demand, require}}, {{cog|nl|eisen|t=to demand, require}}, {{cog|de|heischen|t=to ask, request, implore}}, {{cog|ru|иска́ть}}, {{cog|sa|इच्छति|tr=iccháti}} (whence {{cog|hi|ईछना}}.

====Verb====
{{wikidata lexeme|L53}}
{{en-verb}}

# To [[request]] or [[petition]].
## {{lb|en|transitive|intransitive}} To {{l|en|request}} (information, or an [[answer]] to a [[question]]).
##: {{ux|en|I '''asked''' her age.}}
##: {{ux|en|I didn't know the answer so I '''asked'''.}}
##: {{ux|en|Didn't you think to '''ask''' about Mother?}}
##* {{quote-journal|en|author=Justin Curto|title=The 1975’s Matty Healy Prefers Writing Lyrics He’s Afraid Of|magazine={{w|Vulture.com|Vulture}}|url=https://www.vulture.com/2022/10/the-1975-being-funny-in-a-foreign-language-lyrics.html|date=2022-10-14|passage=Everyone always '''asks''' what my advice is, and my advice is don’t overintellectualize your art.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221018174008/https://www.vulture.com/2022/10/the-1975-being-funny-in-a-foreign-language-lyrics.html}}
## {{lb|en|transitive|or|ditransitive}} To {{l|en|request}} or [[enquire]] of (a person).
##: {{ux|en|I '''asked''' her (for) her age.}}
##: {{ux|en|I’m going to '''ask''' this lady (for) directions.}}
##: {{ux|en|If you want to know, '''ask''' her.}}
##: {{ux|en|'''Ask''' him that he tell her —No need to, she'll already know by know.}}
## {{lb|en|transitive|_|usually with 'for'|or|intransitive}} To request (an item or service) {{q|see also [[ask for]]}}.
##: {{co|en|to '''ask''' for a second helping at dinner}}
##: {{co|en|to '''ask''' for help with homework}}
##: {{co|en|to '''ask''' a favour}}
##: {{ux|en|If you want help, you only have to '''ask'''.}}
##* {{RQ:KJV|Matthew|7|7|passage='''Ask''', and it shall be given you.}}
##* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Christina Maxouris and Doug Criss|title=Everything you wanted to know about Yom Kippur|url=https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/08/us/yom-kippur-meaning-trnd/index.html|date=2019-10-08|passage=Services during Yom Kippur are held continuously through the day and include readings from the Torah and the reciting of prayers expressing regret or '''asking''' for forgiveness.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251010022057/https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/08/us/yom-kippur-meaning-trnd/index.html|archivedate=10 October 2025}}
## {{lb|en|transitive}} To request (someone to do something).
##: {{ux|en|Emma '''asked''' Jim to close his eyes.}}
## To [[request]] [[permission]] (to [[do]] [[something]]).
##: {{ux|en|She '''asked''' to see the doctor.}}
##: {{ux|en|Did you '''ask''' to use the car?}}
# To {{l|en|put forward}} (a question) to be answered.
#: {{co|en|to '''ask''' a question}}
#: {{co|en|to '''ask''' a riddle}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|John|9|21|passage=He is of age; '''ask''' him: he shall speak for himself.}}
# To [[require]], [[demand]], [[claim]], or [[expect]], whether by way of [[remuneration]] or [[return]], or as a [[matter]] of [[necessity]].
#: {{ux|en|What price are you '''asking''' for the house?}}
#: {{ux|en|It’s '''asking''' a lot of this old car to make it all the way up to Scotland.}}
#* {{RQ:Addison Italy
|passage=But in any Exigence of State, like that they are now pressed with, it certainly '''asks''' a much longer time to conduct any Design, for the Good of the Common-wealth, to its Maturity and Perfection.}}
# To [[invite]].
#: {{ux|en|Don’t '''ask''' them to the wedding.}}
# {{lb|en|figurative|chiefly|continuous aspect}} To [[indirectly]] [[encourage]] or make more [[likely]] (an undesirable outcome).
#: {{ux|en|[[walk around|Walking around]] with such an expensive watch is '''asking''' to be mugged.}}
# To publish in church for marriage; said of both the banns and the persons.
# {{lb|en|figuratively}} To [[take]] (a person's situation) as an example.

=====Usage notes=====
* This is a [[catenative]] verb that takes the ''to infinitive''. See [[Appendix:English catenative verbs]]
* Pronouncing ask as /æks/ or /ɑːks/ is a common example of [[metathesis]] (attested since the [[Old English]] period) and still common in some varieties of English, notably [[African American Vernacular English]] (AAVE) and [[Multicultural London English]] (MLE).
* The action expressed by the verb ''[[ask]]'' can also be expressed by the noun-verb combination ''[[pose]] a [[question]]''.

====Noun====
{{wikidata lexeme|L1567858}}
{{en-noun}} {{tlb|en|informal}}

# An act or instance of asking.
# Something asked or asked for.
#: {{syn|en|request}}
#: {{ux|en|I know this is a big '''ask''', but …}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2008|author=Doug Fields; Duffy Robbins|title=Speaking to Teenagers
|passage=Communication researchers call this the foot-in-the-door syndrome. Essentially it's based on the observation that people who respond positively to a small “'''ask'''” are more likely to respond to a bigger “'''ask'''” later on.}}
# An [[asking price]].
# {{lb|en|Internet}} A [[message]] sent to a [[blog]] on [[social networking]] platform [[Tumblr]], which can be publicly posted and replied to by the recipient.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2017|author=Abigail Oakley|editor=Isabel K. Düsterhöft; Paul G. Nixon|chapter=Supporting one another: Nonbinary community building on Tumblr|title=Sex in the Digital Age|pageurl=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Sex_in_the_Digital_Age/NR0xDwAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22asks%22+tumblr&pg=PT120|page=unnumbered
|passage=Answering ''''asks'''<nowiki>'</nowiki> like this is one common way that Tumblr bloggers interact with their followers, so it is in the act of publicly answering these '''asks''' that I examine community building practices.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2018|editor=Amanda Ochsner; William G. Tierney; Zoë B. Corwin|author=Lynette Kvasny; Fay Cobb Payton|chapter=African American Youth Tumbling Toward Mental Health Support-Seeking and Positive Academic Outcomes|title=Diversifying Digital Learning: Online Literacy and Educational Opportunity|url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Diversifying_Digital_Learning/F9lLDwAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22an+ask%22+tumblr&pg=PA162|page=168
|passage=The following example from ''Black Mental Health'' illustrates an '''ask''' from an anonymous follower seeking social support: {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2020|editor=Alexander Cho; Allison McCracken; Indira N. Hoch; Louisa Stein|author=Lee Brown|chapter=Behind the Scenes of a Popular Trans Youth Resources Tumblr|title=A Tumblr Book: Platforms and Cultures|url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/a_tumblr_book/n7UCEAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22asks%22+tumblr&pg=PA265|page=265
|passage=Once the number of unanswered '''Asks''' in the inbox was over eight thousand, despite us deleting everything accumulated in the inbox once a year.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}

===Etymology 2===
{{wikidata lexeme|L1567859}}
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:aske<id:lizard>|id=lizard|tree=1}}
